observations: The current renders supersede the prior missing-part evidence: slanted_back_panel is now displayed in all relevant views rather than being omitted by a degenerate mesh.

Oblique/profile-revealing views 2, 3, 5, and 6 show the upper rear panel spanning between the side panels with a mild Y-Z inclination. Top and bottom views 7 and 8 also confirm its rearward placement and full-width span.

Views 1 and 4 show a broadly symmetrical, height-dominant bookcase with two full-height side panels and exactly three distinct horizontal shelves. The shelf surfaces appear aligned, flat, and free of visibly raised connectors.
All displayed geometry remains monochromatic matte black, and no obvious extra shelf, fused silhouette, or missing major component is visible.

These diagnostic renders support appearance/export approval only. Exact AABB dimensions, assembly topology, interface integrity, mate-frame correctness, fit allowance, and separate print-part assignments require checker evidence rather than visual inference.

issues.problem: All views, especially oblique views 2, 3, 5, and 6, remain very dark against a nearly black background. The low contrast makes side-panel boundaries, shelf edges, and the restored back-panel inclination harder to read than necessary.
issues.suggested_fix: Increase rim or directional lighting, or slightly lift the background/exposure, while preserving the monochromatic matte-black appearance and avoiding contrasting connector colors.
